method: Names were checked against the function lists on the Microsoft Learn DAX category pages (aggregation, date and time, filter, financial, information, logical, math and trig, other, parent and child, relationship, statistical, table manipulation, text, time intelligence, INFO). Every catalog entry was verified to have a Learn page (HTTP 200) and its syntax was taken from that page.
notes: Operators, keywords (VAR, RETURN, DEFINE, EVALUATE, ORDER BY) and constants are not functions and are not catalogued.

The 'catalog_functions_not_on_category_pages' entries (INFO.*, visual calculation and window functions, FIRSTNONBLANK family, TOPNSKIP, T.INV.2T) have their own Learn page but are not links on the category pages.
Descriptions are original short summaries; follow reference_url for the full specification.
